books.title: Grieg: Album of Selected Piano Works
flags: Alphabetical-index page; exact edition/title unknown. All-Grieg (Lyric Pieces, Peer Gynt, etc.).
books.title_suggestion: Grieg: Selected Piano Compositions (e.g. Schirmer's Library Vol. 920 / Album of Selected Works)
books.identification_note: Alphabetical-index page lists Lyric Pieces (Opp. 12, 38, 43, 47, 54, 65, 68, 71), both Peer Gynt suite movements, Norwegian Dances, and the I Love Thee transcription. This contents profile matches a single-volume Grieg piano anthology in the mold of Schirmer's Library of Musical Classics (e.g. Vol. 920) or a comparable 'Selected Works' album. Title left as captured per instruction; edition not confirmable from the index page alone.

songs.title: Album-Leaf, Op. 28, No. 3
songs.notes: Op. 28 No. 3 is the well-known Album Leaf often heard as 'Dance Caprice'; index also lists a separate Dance Caprice entry at the same page.

songs.title: Dance Caprice, Op. 28, No. 3
songs.notes: Same Op. 28 No. 3 piece as the 'Album-Leaf' entry above; index lists it under both names.

songs.title: I Love Thee
songs.from: Melodies of the Heart, Op. 5, No. 3
songs.notes: Piano arrangement of the song 'Jeg elsker Dig' (I Love Thee), Op. 5 No. 3.

songs.title: Peer Gynt Suite (First), Op. 46
songs.notes: Header/group entry for the four-movement suite; individual movements follow.

songs.title: 1. Morning-Mood
songs.notes: Suite movement 1 (= Morning-Mood, Op. 46 No. 1).

songs.title: 2. Ase's Death
songs.notes: Suite movement 2 (= Ase's Death, Op. 46 No. 2).

songs.title: 3. Anitra's Dance
songs.notes: Suite movement 3 (= Anitra's Dance, Op. 46 No. 3).

songs.title: 4. In the Hall of the Mountain-King
songs.notes: Suite movement 4 (= In the Hall of the Mountain-King, Op. 46 No. 4).

songs.title: Remembrances, Op. 71, No. 7
songs.notes: Reprises the Arietta theme (Op. 12 No. 1) as a waltz; Grieg's final Lyric Piece.

songs.title: Skip-Dance, Op. 38, No. 5
songs.notes: Op. 38 No. 5 is the Springdans / 'Spring Dance' (Norwegian leaping dance), here titled Skip-Dance.

songs.title: Solveig's Song, Op. 52, No. 4
songs.notes: Piano transcription of Solveig's Song from Peer Gynt; Op. 52 is Grieg's set of piano transcriptions of his own vocal pieces.

books.title: James Bond: 26 Songs from 24 Films
flags: Back-cover header; exact book title not captured.
books.title_suggestion: The James Bond Collection (Hal Leonard, P/V/G)
books.identification_note: Song list runs Dr. No (1962) through Spectre (2015) and includes the two OHMSS entries plus 'You Know My Name', 'Another Way to Die', and 'Writing's on the Wall'. This matches Hal Leonard's James Bond P/V/G collection covering the films through Spectre. Captured count is 25 titles though the header reads '26 songs'; likely one omitted in capture (possibly an additional incidental theme). Title left as captured per instruction.
